title: Vendor DPA Authority After Acquisition and Entity Name Change
question: As of March 20, 2026, what is the correct compliance status of Meridian's data sharing with the former CloudSync service, and what action is required?

contributor.name: Priya Venkatesh
contributor.title: Information Security & Compliance Manager
contributor.domain_expertise: SOC2, vendor security reviews, data processing agreements, incident disclosure, policy versioning across compliance frameworks

choices: DPA is still valid under the successor clause (Section 9.1); no action required beyond updating the vendor name in Vanta
Processing is unauthorized because Nextera's sub-processor list includes GCP which was never approved; immediately terminate the vendor relationship
DPA is in breach due to late notice but processing can continue because the same team and infrastructure are in place; issue a formal warning letter

Data processing must be suspended within 5 business days of March 18 awareness; the DPA successor clause was not properly invoked (late notice + entity dissolution), and policy SP-007 Section 3.4 mandates suspension
